meta.name: ai-amazon-inventory-management
meta.description: Amazon 库存诊断助手适合运营、产品、销售、software在用户提出“库存会拖住利润吗”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成商品/店铺诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议。

copy.tagline: 诊断亚马逊库存问题并生成运营建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责亚马逊店铺运营，需要快速诊断库存对利润的影响。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose Amazon inventory issues and generate actionable insights
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Amazon store operations and need to quickly assess inventory impact on profits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的商品信息、店铺链接或运营目标，生成库存诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议。
howto.when: 当你询问“库存会拖住利润吗”等库存相关问题时，或需要分析商品/店铺并得到可执行建议时触发。

say.text: 分析这个ASIN的库存周转和利润风险。
say.note: Claude 会调用技能生成诊断报告。

say.text: 根据我的运营目标，给出下一步动作。
say.note: 需提前说明目标，如提升转化率。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate inventory diagnostics, selling points, risk alerts, and operational action suggestions based on product info, store links, or business goals you provide.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask inventory-related questions like 'Will inventory drag down profits?' or need analysis and actionable recommendations for products/stores.

say_en.text: Analyze the inventory turnover and profit risk for this ASIN.
say_en.note: Claude will call the skill to generate a diagnostic report.

say_en.text: Based on my operational goal, give me next steps.
say_en.note: Specify the goal beforehand, e.g., improve conversion rate.
